newsitem.title: UK: NWE GASOLINE SLIPS UP TO $6, MED LOSES LESS.
newsitem.headline: NWE GASOLINE SLIPS UP TO $6, MED LOSES LESS.

text.p: NWE gasoline was several dollars weaker on Monday with barges losing $6 a tonne and cargoes dipping $4-5.
Traders said the anticipation of fresh supplies from the end of this week and waning interest from the U.S. conspired to pull prices off recent highs.
"It been a consolidation of losses late last week," said one dealer.
Eurograde barges traded at $216 fob Rotterdam, down from $221 on Friday with swaps also showing lower numbers.
The balance of August was pegged around $209, but most attention was focused on September which traded at $192.00 and $192.25.
Second half physical barges were attracting levels around $214.

The Mediterranean market was firm compared with the north, and there was some discussion on Monday of taking NWE material into the Med which is tight. "Barges showed the greatest weakness, then NWE cargoes with the Med intermediate," said one trader.
Fresh supplies were expected towards the end of this week, although the larger cargoes will not be available before Aug 20.
